description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Customer Returns Delivery provides a way to interact with the [Customer Returns Delivery (A2X) API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_CUSTOMER_RETURNS_DELIVERY_SRV_0002/overview). The service allows to create, read, update and delete customer returns deliveries with their items, partners and document flow, and to put away items and post or reverse the goods receipt.
key-features: Create, read, update and delete customer returns deliveries and their items
Read delivery partners with their addresses, document flow and serial numbers
Put away one or all items, split batches, and post or reverse the goods receipt
